units.title: Unit-1
topics: Fundamentals of Statically Determinate Structures: Basics: Types of statically determinate & indeterminate structures
Framed structure : Computation of internal forces in statically determinate framed structures such as plane truss
Arches and Cables : Calculation internal forces in three hinge arches with circular and parabolic shapes subjected to various types of loading
Forces and end actions in cables due to various types of loading
Thin cylinder: Analysis of thin cylinder and spherical vessels under pressure

units.title: Unit-2
topics: Strain energy & Displacement of Statically Determinate structures Strain Energy : Resilience
strain energy due to axial loads & flexure
impact loads, and sudden loads Subject Code: 3140603 Displacement : Differential equation of elastic curve
Displacement of beam by Macaulay’s method
Conjugate Beam Method and by strain energy using first principle (i.e equating strain enery to work done)

units.title: Unit-3
topics: Direct and Bending stresses + Column & Struts (A) Direct and Bending stresses Basics: Members subjected to eccentric loads
stress distribution Applications of Direct & Bending stresses : (1) chimney subjected to wind pressure
(2) Retaining walls subjected to earth pressure and (3) Dams subjected to hydraulic pressure
(B) Columns and Struts Basics: Buckling of columns
least radius of gyration Applications: Euler's and Rankine's formulae

units.title: Unit-4
topics: Statically Indeterminate beams Basics : Types of statically indeterminate beams

Propped Cantilever beam : Analysis of propped cantilever beams & beams of varying moment of inertia using Consistent Deformation Method Fixed beam : Computation of fixed-end actions for various types of loads and secondary effects using basic principles
beams of varying moment of inertia
Continuous beams: continuous beam up to 3 spans by Moment Distribution Method

units.title: Unit-5
topics: (for Laboratory only ) Use of professional software such as STAAD-Pro, SAP, ETABS etc. for determining response of frames structure of the topics related to this course Subject Code: 3140603
